title: Broadcasting Act 1994, 2020 Revised Edition (operation 31 December 2021)
header_as_printed: THE STATUTES OF THE REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / BROADCASTING ACT 1994 / 2020 REVISED EDITION / This revised edition incorporates all amendments up to and / including 1 December 2021 and comes into operation on 31 December 2021. / Prepared and Published by / THE LAW REVISION COMMISSION / UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
in_force: The text is the 2020 Revised Edition as printed: "incorporates all amendments up to and including 1 December 2021 and comes into operation on 31 December 2021". It is the text of the Act as at that date, before Act 25 of 2021 s 84 (1 April 2022), S 26/2022 (13 January 2022), Act 31 of 2022 (1 November 2022), Act 38 of 2022 (1 February 2023), Act 4 of 2008 s 3 (1 April 2024) and S 738/2024 (25 September 2024) took effect.
obtained_how: One GET request with curl, User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", at least 5 seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at a URL that the orchestrating session had read off a result on the e-Gazette browse page and passed to the encoder. The assets host serves the PDF with 200. The text file is the output of "pdftotext -layout" (poppler) on the PDF, unedited: the PDF has a text layer, so there was no OCR. The converter may mis-order or drop characters, so the text is an aid for quotation and the PDF is the source.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/ (page says "Last updated on 10 July 2026"), clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; read on 2026-11-03; the wording is quoted in SOURCE-LICENSE-GAZETTE.md.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
